wedge: 서울 공공서비스예약 OpenAPI의 서비스ID·상태·접수시작/종료일시 + 사용자가 고른 종목/권역 => 여러 시설의 앞으로 열릴 예약을 한 캘린더에서 탐색·비교하는 cross-facility opening radar; 개별 서비스 문자알림을 복제하지 않고, 아직 발견하지 못한 서비스까지 '무엇이 언제 열리나'를 선제적으로 보여주는 discovery layer; 자동예약·로그인·자리선점은 하지 않음.
last_material_result: One bounded field/substitute validation materially strengthened data feasibility but weakened the original reminder wedge. Seoul Open Data's current public-reservation literacy page explicitly documents service category/ID/status, direct URL, reception start datetime and reception end datetime as OpenAPI fields. A district OpenAPI specification independently lists RCEPTBEGDT, RCEPTENDDT, capacity, selection method and status fields, so an opening-calendar can be generated without scraping or paid APIs. Current Seoul reservation pages also expose exact reception periods and live status. However, the official reservation site itself already offers per-service SMS notifications including pre-opening, closing-day and notice alerts. Therefore a generic 'notify me when this reservation opens' product is commoditized by the official service and should not be built. The candidate survives only as a narrower cross-facility discovery/calendar layer: filter multiple sports/camping/education categories and surface upcoming openings before the user has found and subscribed to each individual listing. This is wedge attempt 2 after generic opening reminders; cancellation-slot alerts remain excluded because timely vacancy data has not been verified.
economics: KRW0 validation spend. Structured official data supports a static/serverless calendar with bounded maintenance and no scraping. Generic reminder monetization is now weak because Seoul provides free per-service SMS alerts. Surviving economics require discovery/search value across many facilities: organic pages and portfolio cross-promotion first, with ads only after traffic; premium alerts are not assumed. Expected contribution remains unproven and likely micro-asset scale unless cross-facility discovery has meaningful repeat use.
next_checkpoint: Next Lane C run: test whether users currently face meaningful cross-facility discovery fragmentation for tennis/camping/swimming and whether Seoul's own search/calendar already exposes upcoming reception openings well enough. Compare at least three wedges before KILL: (1) generic opening reminder — now rejected due official SMS; (2) cross-facility upcoming-opening calendar — current survivor; (3) personalized weekly 'next 14 days opening' digest across selected categories/areas. KILL if official search/calendar or a dominant free product already solves cross-facility discovery, or if upcoming listings cannot be retrieved early enough to create lead time. Do not build yet.
recommendation: KEEP / ASSESS with a narrowed discovery wedge. Do not request BUILD: official SMS materially removes the simplest value proposition. One more bounded substitute/distribution check is required on cross-facility discovery before VALIDATE or KILL.
